title: Add Free Tier plan and chart export functionality

requirements.text: Add a Free Tier subscription plan at $0/year with a limit of 3 models per year
acceptanceCriteria: Backend enum includes a #free tier option
Free tier users are limited to 3 models per year
Free tier is available alongside existing Premium tier

requirements.text: Update ProfileSetupModal to display and allow selection between Free Tier ($0/year - 3 models/year) and Premium Tier ($235/year - 300 models/year) during initial profile creation
acceptanceCriteria: Profile setup modal shows both tier options with pricing and limits
Users can select either Free or Premium tier during signup
Selected tier is saved to the user profile

requirements.text: Update SubscriptionModal to display Free Tier option and allow upgrades from Free to Premium
acceptanceCriteria: Subscription modal displays Free Tier information when applicable
Free tier users see upgrade option to Premium
Upgrade flow initiates Stripe checkout for Premium tier

requirements.text: Limit Free Tier users to 2 export operations (CSV and PDF combined) with a counter displayed in the UI

quotes: Make just 2 free exports for the user on the free plan

acceptanceCriteria: Backend tracks export count separately from model count for Free tier users
Free tier users can perform exactly 2 exports total
Export buttons are disabled after 2 exports with a message prompting upgrade
Export counter is displayed in the ExportTab showing remaining exports

requirements.text: Add individual export buttons to each chart component (CostBreakdownPieChart, CumulativeCashFlowChart, ProductionBarChart) that allow users to download the chart as an image file

quotes: Add export button for the chart images

acceptanceCriteria: Each chart has a visible export button (e.g., icon button in top-right corner)
Clicking export button downloads the chart as a PNG image file
Export uses browser-native methods (canvas toBlob/toDataURL or similar) since html2canvas is not available
Exported filename includes chart type and timestamp

requirements.text: Update DashboardHeader subscription usage display to show model usage and export usage separately for Free tier users

quotes: Make just 2 free exports for the user on the free plan

acceptanceCriteria: Free tier users see both 'Models: X/3' and 'Exports: X/2' in the header
Premium tier users only see model usage as before
Display updates after each model save or export action

constraints: Maintain single-actor architecture for all backend logic
Preserve existing Premium tier functionality at $235/year for 300 models/year
Do not modify immutable frontend paths: useInternetIdentity hooks, useActor.ts, main.tsx, or components/ui
Use only React, Tailwind CSS, and React Query for frontend implementation
Export counting must not interfere with existing model counting logic
nonGoals: Changing the Premium tier pricing or model limits
Adding additional subscription tiers beyond Free and Premium
Adding analytics or tracking beyond basic usage counters
